description:
Play Nine Men’s Morris on iPhone and iPad with a clear board, gentle stone movements and room to consider your next move.

Challenge the computer, take turns on one device, or play on two devices connected to the same Wi-Fi network. Choose Nine Men’s Morris, Twelve Men’s Morris, Morabaraba or Lasker Morris. Five difficulty levels offer different challenges.

For a Wi-Fi game, one person hosts and the other sends an invitation. Accept it to play without a pairing code. All four variants are supported. Saved games can reconnect after an interruption. Hints and undo are unavailable in network games.

Hints show a suggested move directly on the board. Turn legal targets and last-move markers on or off to suit your preferences. Review the move history or undo a move to reconsider a decision.

Your current game is saved locally. All computer moves are calculated on your device. No account or internet connection is needed to play.

• Four variants and five computer levels
• Two players on one device or two devices on the same Wi-Fi network
• Visual hints and adjustable playing aids
• Move history and undo
• Portrait and landscape on iPhone and iPad
• English, German, French, Spanish, Japanese, Korean and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional)
• No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases

Muehlenstein is an independently designed native app using the free Sanmill game engine. Complete source code and license notices are publicly available. Play over the internet is not included.
promotionalText: Now play on two devices on the same Wi-Fi network, with invitations, four Morris variants and saved games you can reconnect to. No ads or account required.
whatsNew: Play on either display of iPhone Duo and fold or unfold it mid-game. In book posture, the board sits on the left with the controls centered beside it. On the outer display, use the toolbar on the right to undo a move, get a hint, or open History. When reviewing a game, use the same toolbar to step backward or forward through the moves.
